Hunter Brown allowed just one hit and struck out eight over six innings on Tuesday night as the Astros hammered the Red Sox 9-2. Yordan Alvarez and Cam Smith slugged solo homers while Christian Walker and Carlos Correa provided two-run singles in the rout. Cody Bolton fanned five while picking up a three-inning save. Connor Wong’s RBI double in the fifth inning was the only hit the Red Sox got off Brown, with Ceddanne Rafaela connecting for a solo home run in the eighth. Brayan Bello got roughed up for six runs, five earned, and couldn’t get out of the fifth inning. Boston is hitting just .174 with 10 runs scored during its losing streak. Right-hander Mike Burrows gets the start for Houston after taking the loss in his debut for the Astros on Friday, surrendering five runs on nine hits in 5.2 innings against the Los Angeles Angels.
